description: This file defines a static utility class 'StableHash' that provides methods for computing hash digests of input data, using xxHash and handling byte order considerations.

classes.name: StableHash
classes.description: Provides static methods for computing hash digests from byte arrays or strings, with platform endianness handling.

methods.name: ComputeHash(ReadOnlySpan<byte> data)
methods.description: Computes a hash digest for the provided byte span using xxHash32, with endianness adjustment.

methods.name: ComputeHash(string data)
methods.description: Computes a hash digest for the given string, converting it to bytes with appropriate endianness handling.
